newsitem.title: USA: Delta worker dies beneath wheels of jet at JFK.
newsitem.headline: Delta worker dies beneath wheels of jet at JFK.

text.p: A Delta Airlines employee was killed on Thursday when he fell beneath the wheels of a moving jumbo jet at Kennedy International Airport, officials said.
"A Delta employee died when he fell beneath the wheels of the aircraft as it was being pushed back from the gate," Tracey Bowen, a Delta spokesperson said.
The accident, which involved Delta Flight 82, an L1011 aircraft bound for Nice, France, occurred at 6:20 p.m. EST, Bowen said.
She said the airline was still investigating the accident and that none of the passengers were injured, but they had been removed from the aircraft and were being put on other flights.
